purpose: Map the reusable legacy work packages, ADRs, SEMP controls, release boundaries, and unmerged references to this program without activating an old candidate or treating historical evidence as current qualification.

scope.review_basis: The crosswalk uses committed release source clauses and bounded historical inventories. SEMP clauses are read-only custody references from the preserved original untracked checkout, not checked-in release sources. Co-Engineer inventory is corroborating review input; source files, hashes, custody markers, and explicit constraints control the disposition.
scope.activation_rule: A mapped legacy work package or branch is a reuse or constraint reference only. It does not authorize deployment, source access, paid provisioning, planner enablement, identity adjudication, scientific promotion, or a production cutover.

plan_and_execution.role: worktree, atomic commit, handoff, and publication workflow

adr_index.omission_disposition: Retain and map ADR-0007 explicitly; do not interpret the README index omission as retirement.

adrs.key_clauses: Ports keep public delivery separate from connectors and mutable control-plane state; StaticAssetCatalogRepository remains the rollback adapter until WP14 retirement gates pass; migrations are forward-only.

Public requests do not harvest, fetch source payloads, mutate identity, grant authorization, run analysis, or enable planner/toolkit capabilities; result envelopes preserve false and unresolved states.
Released contract directories are immutable; additive versions carry shared semantic services and translation boundaries.

Source-native identity and family evidence remain distinct from adjudication; automatic resolution is disabled; legacy joins remain candidate, ambiguous, unknown, or blocked until qualified evidence exists.
PostgreSQL is canonical; search/R2 are not; publication is immutable and last-good; raw source payloads and credentials are excluded; rollback is pointer, Worker-version, or static fallback.

The target public search path is bounded and indexed and may not scan unbounded JSONL; StaticSearchBackend is retained for fixtures and emergency rollback. The checked release still serves static ASSETS/JSONL, so that fact is a current/emergency boundary rather than a silent waiver.
Historical schema bytes remain unrecovered; local successor validation is not proof of historical recovery and does not repin old receipts.
WP14 v1.0.0 remains sealed; v1.1.0 is additive local/CI evidence only and grants no deploy, provider mutation, release-gate, or production-eligibility authority.

source_custody.original_path_status: docs/semp is present only as an untracked path in the preserved original checkout

path_resolution_rule.current_base: Treat all four repository-relative SEMP paths as absent and unavailable in the selected base unless a future candidate contains the path and its expected SHA256.
path_resolution_rule.preserved_original: Until then, resolve the four paths only beneath original_checkout, require original_captured_head and preservation_manifest.sha256 to match, and verify each listed file SHA256 before reading it.
path_resolution_rule.reuse_or_promotion: A future reuse must create an explicitly versioned committed custody or import record and receive independent review. This correction does not copy or import the SEMP tree, activate its generated views, or promote its IDs or claims to production.

stable_id_scope.rule: The stable_ids below refer to local-only IDs in the preserved original SEMP model and evidence. They do not assert selected-base files, generated views, active policy, authorization, scientific approval, or production facts.

generated_views.policy: The canonical model is the source. Generated Markdown/Mermaid views are never hand-edited; PR-001 adds no generated SEMP view.

control_mappings.reason: Every listed gate is a proposed SEMP review control that can constrain later evidence and release decisions; PR-001 preserves the map, PR-003 consumes executable evidence controls, PR-079 independently reviews them, and PR-082 closes the exact release chain.
retained_constraints: Gate presence or a proposed proceed option does not establish verification, validation, qualification, acceptance, authorization, activation, deployment, or scientific approval.
A gate may be reused only as a typed control after its exact subject, scope, authority, expiry, evidence, and custody are independently resolved.
No gate authorizes source payload retrieval, paid provider use, planner enablement, identity adjudication, or production mutation.
control_mappings.supersession: none; no selected-base release artifact supersedes these local-only controls

control_mappings.reason: Every listed transition expresses a proposed control-state relationship between the retained review gates; the mapping preserves that relationship for downstream traceability without asserting that any transition executed.
retained_constraints: Transition edges are map references only and cannot move a candidate between lifecycle, authorization, activation, or operational states.
Any reuse must bind the edge to a current exact candidate, decision record, authority, evidence package, and expiry; revise or return edges remain available when a prior baseline is invalid.
No transition bypasses the selected-base SEMP absence, independent review, or production authorization boundaries.
control_mappings.supersession: none; no selected-base release artifact supersedes these local-only transitions

control_mappings.reason: Every listed DWP is a bounded planning, authority, evidence, claims, or release-control record whose typed state helps downstream consumers understand what was proposed, completed, rejected, or left incomplete.
retained_constraints: DWP state and output IDs remain historical or candidate planning evidence; completed or passed technical steps do not prove scientific approval, acceptance, authorization, deployment, activation, or fitness.
Reuse requires exact artifact custody, current scope, named authority, independent review, and explicit handling of blocked, unavailable, rejected, expired, and evidence-incomplete states.
No DWP grants permission for source payload import, paid enrichment, provider mutation, planner execution, identity merge, or production change.
control_mappings.supersession: none; no selected-base release artifact supersedes these local-only work-package controls

stable_ids.package_disposition: Retain the package sequence and typed pending/not_requested states as planning controls. No package state is promoted to a deployment, scientific, acceptance, or operating authorization.

source_and_evidence_ids.disposition: Retain these IDs as traceability anchors; unresolved, inferred, conflicting, and unsearched states remain typed and do not become claims of completion.

parent_register.status: AUTH-01 through AUTH-17 not_requested and authorized false

effective_successor.loader_limitation: verification/external-authorization/v1.1.0/tools/effective-register.mjs overlays the delta but does not enforce expires_at; the crosswalk applies expiry and branch scope explicitly.

ap01.constraint: There is no authenticated production principal source, handler inventory disposition, or owner residual-risk acceptance for caller-supplied audit identity.

authorization.publication_scope: The current project owner approval for public GitHub code, planning, and sanitized evidence is a publication authorization outside the scientific/external-authorization register. It does not authorize deployment, paid enrichment, source payload access, planner or identity enablement, or scientific promotion.

review_input.use_rule: The report supplied leads and omission checks; source clauses and checked-in hashes control this crosswalk.
